title: HVAC and Plumbing in Shavano Park, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in Shavano Park, TX and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: Since 2003, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air has been the local expert for heating, cooling, and plumbing services across Shavano Park, TX. We’ve replaced broken-down air conditioners in the middle of triple-digit heatwaves, stopped water heater leaks from damaging floors, and helped homeowners cut energy bills with efficient new systems. Whether we’re conducting an emergency repair or routine maintenance, our team isn’t finished until the work is done right.

We provide HVAC and plumbing services throughout Shavano Park, backed by licensed professionals, top-tier tools, and a local reputation built over two decades. Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is a top contractor with NATE-certified technicians and won the 2023 Neighborhood Fave award from Nextdoor. We also have an A+ rating with the BBB. From tune-ups to complete system installs, we bring solutions that are built for real Texas homes.

HVAC issues tend to show up at the worst possible times, whether during a heatwave or a cold front that pushes your system past its limits. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we service all types of residential HVAC equipment with a focus on fast response, honest assessments, and long-term performance. If your AC is blowing warm air, short-cycling, or not turning on at all, we’ll get a technician out quickly with the tools and parts needed to get it working again.

We also handle HVAC installations, including ductless mini-splits and heat pumps, and offer free estimates on new systems. If you’re interested in preventative care, our Comfort Club Membership includes biannual tune-ups, first-priority scheduling, and discounts on repairs. It’s a smart way to keep your system running efficiently through every season in Shavano Park.

Plumbing problems can damage your home and run up your water bill fast. That’s why Rosenberg Plumbing & Air focuses on accurate diagnostics. Whether you’re facing a slab leak hidden under tile flooring or a water heater that isn’t producing hot water, we come prepared with the tools and experience to solve the issue efficiently. Our goal? To address the root cause.

We also offer a dedicated Plumbing Maintenance Program that includes a full system inspection, water heater flush, toilet leak checks, and discounts on any needed repairs. It’s a proactive way to avoid emergencies and help your plumbing system last longer, especially in older homes where wear and tear is more common.
